page.description: Q4OS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A lightweight, Debian-based desktop operating system offering both the advanced Plasma and the efficient Trinity desktop environments. Features unique tools like Desktop Profiler and Lookswitcher.
pros: Rock-stable Debian foundation with five years of LTS support
Choice of Plasma or Trinity desktop, installable side-by-side
Extremely lightweight; runs well on 6-year-old hardware
Exclusive Windows installer for easy dual-boot alongside Windows
cons: Donation page is presented before direct download links
Plasma edition has grown larger, no longer contains Trinity packages by default
Smaller community and fewer third-party resources
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Q4OS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO to a USB stick with dd, Rufus, or BalenaEtcher. Alternatively, use the Q4OS Imager tool or the Windows installer for dual-boot setups.

editions.name: Plasma Desktop
editions.description: The primary edition with KDE Plasma 6 desktop, featuring the stock Debian look or Q4OS Debonaire theme.
editions.usbNote: 1.9 GB image. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.

editions.name: Trinity Desktop
editions.description: Lightweight edition with the efficient Trinity desktop, ideal for older or resource-constrained hardware.
